title: Phase I/II Clinical Study to Assess the Safety, Efficacy and Select the Dose of NFL-102 as a Tobacco and Nicotine Cessation Therapy (TONIC trial)
official: Phase I/II Clinical Study to Assess the Safety, Efficacy and Select the Dose of NFL-102 as a Tobacco and Nicotine Cessation Therapy (TONIC trial)
summary:
Main objective: Part A: To assess the safety and tolerability of three escalating dose levels of NFL-102 and select two doses for part B
Part B: To select the optimal dose of NFL-102 for further development based on the overall assessment of efficacy and safety
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Male or female tobacco smokers≥ 18 and ≤ 70-years-old
2. Currently smoking at least 11 tobacco cigarettes per day with a dependency level ≥ 3 as determined by the Fagerström Test for Nicotine Dependence
3. Whose expired air carbon monoxide (CO) is ≥10 ppm
4. Willing to attempt to quit smoking
5. Willing to make a quit attempt at D1 after the first product administration
6. Routine biological and hematological tests and vital signs within the laboratory’s normal range or considered not clinically significant (NCS) by the investigator
7. Having consented in writing for their participation in the study
Exclusion criteria:
1. Pregnant and breastfeeding women
2. Known allergy to tobacco leaf
3. Prior (within previous 15 days) or concomitant use of any smoking cessation therapy (including nicotine patch and gum,electronic cigarettes and including alternative methods such as hypnosis or acupuncture or non-nicotinic cigarettes)
4. Concurrent participation in another clinical trial
5. Prior exposure to NFL-101 or tobacco leaf extracts used for desensitization
6. Concomitant active infectious diseases as per investigator’s judgement
7. Any uncontrolled medical condition
8. History or presence of alcohol abuse
